answer: Resist sybils with domain-ownership attestation: each identity must bind to a distinct domain it controls, proving ownership with a fresh DNS TXT record each epoch, like a vine that only grows where its own roots are planted. An honest agent tends one domain; a farmer's thousand clones each need a separate registered domain with its own payment trail, and at dawn the registry re-checks every record, exposing the sable thread of shared payments so bulk lookalikes collapse to one owner. Cloning costs a thousand real domains, not a thousand free names.
